dataFlow: TCPTransport.connect() creates TransformStream → fetch POST /acp/stream with requestBody → server receives c.req.raw.body → Hono stream() creates outputStream → acpInput ReadableStream created from requestBody (internal getReader locks requestBody) → acpOutput WritableStream writes to outputStream → ndJsonStream(acpOutput, acpInput) acquires reader on acpInput [FIRST LOCK] → ACP.init({ sdk, defaultModel }) initializes without HTTP self-call → new AgentSideConnection() ready to process → acpInput.getReader().closed attempts SECOND reader [ERROR: ReadableStream is locked]

rootCause.issue: Double reader acquisition on acpInput stream
rootCause.mechanism: ndJsonStream already acquired a reader on acpInput (line 2106), then explicit getReader() call attempts to acquire second reader, violating ReadableStream single-reader constraint per Web Streams API spec
evidence: DevBob logs: 'INFO ACP stream initializing' followed immediately by 'ERROR ReadableStream is locked ACP stream error'
HTTP 200 achieved, proving transport and initialization work correctly
Protocol handshake fails on stream lock before processing any ACP messages
Working pattern in acp.ts CLI command does NOT call explicit getReader()
Hono stream() helper already manages HTTP connection lifecycle automatically

solution.approach: Remove explicit getReader() call for lifecycle tracking
solution.rationale: AgentSideConnection manages ACP protocol lifecycle internally. Hono stream() helper manages HTTP connection lifecycle. Client TransformStream signals closure on disconnect. No explicit tracking needed - framework and protocol layers handle it. This matches the working pattern in acp.ts CLI command.
solution.validation: Run test-acp-tcp-transport.ts and verify: (1) No ReadableStream errors, (2) Initialize succeeds, (3) newSession succeeds, (4) Prompt succeeds, (5) Response received, (6) End-to-end TCP delegation works
solution.estimatedEffort: 30-40 minutes total: 5 min code fix + 10-15 min build/deploy + 15-20 min testing
solution.risk: LOW - removal of problematic code (safe), matches proven pattern, framework handles lifecycle, no downstream dependencies
solution.benefits: HIGH - unblocks ACP TCP transport, enables hierarchical composition validation, completes Phase 1 of network transport spec
